mentions.name: Routing24
mentions.description: A free route optimization tool for planning multi-vehicle, multi-stop routes. It runs multi-threaded WebAssembly for route optimization and bundles geocoding, OSM maps and routing, available world-wide. Planned features include a driver's PWA, saving and sharing of route optimization projects, editing of optimized routes, sharing routes for execution or approval, integrations, and AI-assisted data imports.
mentions.audience: Businesses needing to plan multi-vehicle multi-stop routes.

mentions.name: Routing24
mentions.description: A free route optimization tool for businesses that generates optimized routes for companies operating 1 to 50 vehicles. It runs a local-first route optimization engine in the browser and relies on OpenStreetMap, keeping operational expenses low and flat while helping businesses realize savings from automated route planning.
mentions.audience: Businesses and companies operating from 1 to 50 vehicles
